title: What Makes a Property Reel Get Watched and Shared
description: A property video is watched or skipped in seconds. What the opening, framing and ending of a good property reel have in common.
h1: What makes a property reel get watched: opening, framing and ending
lead: Most property videos lose viewers in the first seconds. The ones that hold attention follow a few simple habits.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

paras: Start with the view, the entrance or the feature a buyer cares about, not with a logo or a long intro.

bullets: Move slowly and keep the camera stable
Show the approach, then the space, then the detail
Keep it short enough to finish

blocks.h: Say who, where and how much
paras: Give the location, size and a way to enquire in the video or caption. Viewers who like it should know what to do next.
